intro: Is this laptop slow, and if so why? Measured at idle on AC power, 5.9 hours after a cold boot. Nothing on the machine was changed.

meta.label: Hardware
meta.value: i7-1165G7 · 4 cores / 8 threads · 32 GB single-channel · 2× NVMe

verdict.label: Not slow
verdict.text: 11 of the 12 healthy-range checks pass at idle. The one that fails is **stability**: the reliability index is 4.38 and falling, because Store app updates and a Lenovo updater keep failing. Everything below is tuning and housekeeping, not a fault.

checks.healthy: over 1,000 MB/s, within 10 min of boot

findings_intro: None of these is a fault. Each is background work or a stability cost, most noticeable first.

findings.title: Power mode is Balanced while plugged in
findings.evidence: The slider is **Balanced** on AC. Lenovo Intelligent Thermal Solution sets the CPU power limits from it. Prove it: switch to Best performance, run a heavy task and compare `% Processor Performance`.

fix.label: no admin · reversible
fix.text: Or **Settings › System › Power & battery › Power mode › Best performance**. To undo, run `powercfg /overlaysetactive overlay_scheme_balanced`.

findings.title: Leftover startup entries
findings.evidence: **Logitech Download Assistant** has a Task Manager approval entry and no program behind it.

plan.text: Set power mode to Best performance while on AC.
plan.why: Raises the CPU's sustained power limit.

fine: **Boot:** no service timeouts (7009) and no failed boot drivers (7026) in 30 days.
**Disks:** both NVMe drives Healthy, 0% wear, TRIM on.
fixed: **Single-channel RAM:** the board has one memory slot.
unmeasured: **Cold-cache disk speed:** the machine had been up 5.9 hours, so the read test measured RAM cache.
